generation_capture.final_message: Homomorphism multiplication and inversion are defined pointwise in the codomain. Thus coercion to functions preserves these operations, and precomposition commutes with them: \((g^{-1})\circ f=(g\circ f)^{-1}\) and \((fg)(x)=f(x)g(x)\). Consequently, every proposition appearing on either side of both equivalences expresses the same pointwise mechanism.
